app_accessibility.code:
const settings = await device.accessibility()
console.log(settings.bold_text, settings.reduce_motion)

app_alert.code:
const text = await device.alert()
if (text) console.log(`A dialog is up: ${text}`)

app_battery.code:
const battery = await device.battery()
console.log(battery.level, battery.state)

app_clear_data.code:
const cleared = await device.clearData('com.example.shop')
console.log(cleared.emptied, cleared.kept)

app_cookies.code:
const cookies = await device.cookies()
for (const c of cookies) console.log(c.name, c.domain)

app_crashes.code:
const crashes = await device.crashes({ app: 'com.example.shop' })
for (const c of crashes) console.log(c.time, c.kind, c.summary)

app_find.code:
const buttons = await device.find('role=button')
console.log(buttons.map((b) => b.label))

app_install.code:
const installed = await device.install('./build/app-debug.apk')
console.log(installed) // the absolute path

app_list_apps.code:
const apps = await device.apps()
for (const app of apps) console.log(app.id, app.version)

app_logs.code:
const { entries } = await device.deviceLogs({ app: 'com.example.shop', level: 'error' })
for (const e of entries) console.log(e.time, e.tag, e.message)

app_record.code:
const video = await device.record({ action: 'stop', path: 'flow.mp4' })
console.log(video.frames, video.duration)

app_session.code:
import { start } from 'mobium'
const device = await start({ app: 'com.android.settings' })

app_time.code:
const { time, zone } = await device.deviceTime()
console.log(time, zone)

app_wait_for.code:
const welcome = await device.waitFor('text=Welcome back')
console.log(welcome?.ref)

start.title: Open a session on the one running device
Pick the device and platform, and launch an app
start.code:
import { start } from 'mobium'
const device = await start({ platform: 'ios', device: 'booted', app: 'com.apple.Preferences' })

connect.title: Connect without opening a session, and leave it open
connect.code:
import { connect } from 'mobium'
const device = await connect({ device: 'emulator-5554' })
console.log(await device.current())
await device.close()

connect.title: Give each parallel run a daemon of its own
connect.code:
import { connect } from 'mobium'
const device = await connect({ device: 'emulator-5556', session: 'run2', callTimeoutMs: 60000 })

findBinary.title: Find the mobium executable a connection would run
findBinary.code:
import { findBinary } from 'mobium'
console.log(findBinary()) // MOBIUM_BIN_PATH, else the first on PATH

errorFrom.title: Turn a tool's error result into the matching exception

session.title: See what start() opened
session.code:
const { device: id, platform, driver, reused } = device.session ?? {}
console.log(id, platform, driver, reused)

sessions.title: List the sessions open on the daemon
sessions.code: for (const s of await device.sessions()) console.log(s.device, s.platform, s.driver)

quit.title: End the session, whatever happens

close.title: Close the connection and keep the session for the CLI

MobiumError.title: Decide by the error's code, never its message

NoSuchElementError.title: Treat a missing element as an answer

TimedOutError.title: Wait, and say what happened if it never came

UnsupportedError.title: Skip what a platform cannot do

answerAlert.title: Fill a prompt's field and accept it, in one call

intro.note: `device` below is what `start()` or `connect()` resolved to: a `Device`. Every method returns a promise.
